name: Appointment Notes
description: What the doctor or adviser said: findings, advice, prescriptions and next appointment.
outline: Summarize why the appointment took place and the main findings or advice, in plain language.
List instructions exactly as given: medication, dose, timing, lifestyle advice, tests.
Note follow-up appointments and any deadline or date mentioned.
List the questions the person still wants to ask.
This is a personal record of what was said; do not add medical advice of your own.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Instructions
- Take one tablet each morning with food

## Follow-up
- Blood test in two weeks
